notes.title: Playtest hotfix 2
notes.content:
Version 0.2:
-Fixed main menu not working correctly
-Fixed crash in tutorial sequence
-Fixed mouse click activating button no matter where you clicked

That's it for day 1, thanks everyone who has played so far, very sorry for the inconvenient crash in the tutorial section, should be fixed now!

notes.title: Playtest hotfix 1
notes.content:
Version 0.1:
-Closed gun merchant room
-Fixed items only dropping adrenaline shots
-Fixed room near item shop looping

This little hotfix is one of maybe many during this playtest.
The game is expected to have bugs and crashes during this playtest, please be patient! I'll try to fix as many bugs as i can.

Thanks for playing and helping me out!
